openwrt_wiki.Beschreibung: TP-Link CPE710 is an outdoor wireless CPE for 5 GHz with one Ethernet port based on the AP152 reference board.
openwrt_wiki.Antenne: built-in 23dBi high-gain directional 2×2 MIMO antenna and a dedicated metal reflector, with a beamwidth of 9° (Azimuth) and 7° (Elevation)
openwrt_wiki.Funk: MCS 0-9 (up through 256 QAM), up to 867Mbps. Supports DFS channels, from channel 36 up to 173 (may vary on each region)
openwrt_wiki.Ports/Strom: It has one PoE 1Gbps LAN port. Power comes from its external 24V, 0.5A power adapter.
openwrt_wiki.Installation TFTP: hold reset button while powering on for around 30-40 seconds; Stock device TFTP address 192.168.0.254; TFTP server 192.168.0.100; file recovery.bin; u-boot: run flashimg, setenv boot_part 1, saveenv
openwrt_wiki.Technical Details: Once the device is updated to version 1.1.2 Build 20251113 or later, the U-Boot bootloader is modified to enforce strict RSA signature verification (TFTP-Recovery und UART nehmen kein OpenWrt mehr an, kein Downgrade). Warnung: nicht auf Herstellerfirmware 1.1.2 oder neuer aktualisieren.
openwrt_wiki.Revisionen: 2026-07-27 lessload; 2026-04-25 jehos "on CPE710 v2, Firmware version 1.1.2 Build 20251113 and later have a locked bootloader"; 2025-03-14 davidezbor; 2023-03-13 danitool; 2023-02-22 redalert
